encounters.description: A cracked sanctum shrine still burns with a god's spoiled light. An angel might leave an offering here to learn what the fallen still demand.

choices.description: Bleed a little of your light into the shrine.
Pass without kneeling.
Accept the Brand: gain 50 Gold and Brand of the Damned. In future battles, every Strength gain is reduced by 1 per copy (minimum 0).
Swear the Blood Oath: gain 70 Gold and Blood-Oath Sigil. In future battles, lose 2 HP per copy at the start of each player turn, bypassing Block and Armour (minimum 1 HP).

encounters.description: A faded attendant still tends the hurt along the sanctum road, following orders that once meant mercy. An angel could accept that help without asking who gives it.

choices.description: Buy the attendant's restorative draught.
Accept a spare bandage for the road.
Decline and continue the climb.

encounters.description: A flooded sanctum court bars the way upward. An angel must choose how to cross without abandoning the path.

choices.description: Pay a silent ferryman for safe passage.
Wade the flood alone.

encounters.description: Beneath the sanctum, old workings still hold relics of the fallen. Lasting penalties in future battles, per copy: Brand of the Damned (Strength gains -1, min 0); Blood-Oath Sigil (player turn-start -2 HP, bypasses Block/Armour, min 1 HP); Shattered Aegis (Block gains -1, min 0); Ashen Ember (max Energy -1 in subsequent battles, min 1).

choices.description: Explore the Mine: gain 60 Gold; 50% chance of one random, lasting Curse.
Leave

encounters.description: An old wishing fountain shimmers beside the path.

choices.description: Make a wish at the fountain.
Leave the fountain without making a wish.

encounters.description: A masked dice keeper invites you to test your luck with two dice.

choices.description: Predict Low (2-6).
Predict High (8-12).
Take the Lucky Seven offer.
Double down on another prediction.
Cash out the current Gold stake.
Risk the current Gold stake in round two.

encounters.description: An ancient forge offers to fuse three of your Common cards into one Rare card.

choices.description: Choose three Common cards to fuse.
Leave the forge without fusing cards.
